name: LoveSpark Hyperfocus Guard
description: ADHD hyperfocus awareness. Gently alerts when you've been on one site too long. Badge shows time-on-site. Configurable threshold. No shame, just awareness. Always free.

data_collection_permissions.justification: This extension does not collect, transmit, or store any user data. Tab info is used locally to track time-on-site. tabs permission required for detecting active tab domain changes.
